sources.title: Step-free access
sources.verified_claim: TfL lists current step-free coverage and ongoing station upgrades, while distinguishing street-to-platform from full level access. Network-level status does not prove a fully accessible journey from a sample parcel.

sources.title: Wheelchair access & avoiding stairs
sources.verified_claim: TfL explains accessible vehicles, step-free station categories, ramps and journey planning and warns users to check disruptions before travel. General accessibility provision is not a static parcel-to-destination accessibility score.

sources.title: Transport accessibility
sources.verified_claim: TfL's accessibility hub links live journey planning, maps, door-to-door services and disability support. Service availability is transport context rather than exact parcel accessibility evidence.

sources.title: Download accessibility guides and maps
sources.verified_claim: TfL publishes step-free and accessible-network maps that distinguish street-to-platform and interchange capabilities. Map availability does not substitute for an exact geocoded journey or current disruption check.

sources.title: Transport planning and policy
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's Transport Plan includes making the public transport network more accessible and the natural choice for longer trips. Strategic intent is not current parcel_30762 service frequency or step-free journey evidence.

sources.title: Havering Local Implementation Plan: Transport strategy
sources.verified_claim: Havering's LIP tracks borough targets against Mayor's Transport Strategy outcomes, including accessibility objectives. Borough targets and historic baselines do not establish parcel_46142 current network accessibility.

sources.title: Active Travel Strategy Adoption
sources.verified_claim: Havering adopted a 2026-2041 Active Travel Strategy aimed at making walking, cycling and public transport preferred modes. Adoption confirms strategy status but not site-specific service or accessible-route quality.

sources.title: Inclusive and accessible
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth sets outcomes for an accessible transport network, step-free stations and highway improvements. Outcome targets do not establish parcel_61522 present accessibility without an exact journey and network-state check.
